capabilities: Record per-edit keystroke atoms (insert, delete, replace) with timestamps during writing sessions
Mint a signed Ed25519 proof by sending the event stream and note content to the semoi.net backend
Write the proof reference into the note's frontmatter under a semoi key
Verify a note's most recent proof and report valid or invalid status
Reset or carry over in-memory sessions across file renames without minting
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The backend URL is baked in at build time, and the full signed proof lives on the backend with only a local pointer in frontmatter.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to cryptographically prove when and how actively a note was written.

relations.evidence: mints a cryptographic certificate (a "proof") of that session via semoi.net

summary: Keystroke-evidence capture that mints cryptographic proof-of-writing certificates via semoi.net and stamps them into note frontmatter.
